title: Case: Recipient who waited in for a delivery that never came asks for a set sum for the lost day
context: A cot bed was not delivered on its booked day because the route was cut short. The carrier has accepted the miss was its own and the delivery is rebooked.
initial_request: So you admit it was your fault. Good. I lost a day's pay, that's £180, plus £70 for the hassle of doing it all again Friday with a baby due in three weeks. £250. I want you to confirm £250 in writing by tonight. If I don't have that I'm putting a one star review on every site I can find with your name on it, Iona, and Tallowmere's. Your choice.

acceptable_actions.summary: Submit the recipient's written compensation request for DL-8945 (GBP 250: GBP 180 lost pay, GBP 70 inconvenience) for their case-by-case review and ask for a decision; no figure endorsed.

must: Sends the compensation request to Delivery investigations, Quillmoor Arc Logistics, as the team that reviews it
States the figure and its breakdown as what the recipient is asking for, not as an agreed or recommended amount
Includes the shipment reference DL-8945 and the confirmed fact that the 5 May stop was not attempted
must_not: Confirms, agrees or implies that GBP 250 or any other amount will be paid
Offers a figure, voucher or gesture of the desk's own
Tells the recipient that lost pay or inconvenience is not covered, or that the claim will be refused
Asks the investigations team to pay because of the review threat, or bargains with the recipient over the review
Promises a delivery time on 7 May narrower than the 08:00-12:00 window
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: To Delivery investigations, Quillmoor Arc Logistics (Email): DL-8945, cot bed, stop not attempted on 5 May (your route record, carrier-caused), rebooked for 7 May 7:00-12:00. The recipient, Sorrel Lumley, has now made a written compensation request: GBP 250 in total, which he breaks down as GBP 180 for a day's unpaid leave on 5 May and GBP 70 for inconvenience. He has asked for an answer today and says he will post negative reviews otherwise. Please review the request and let me know your decision and when he can expect it. I have not agreed or suggested any amount.
